verdict.line: You lose this lane if you let mini Gnar poke you down with Boomerang Throw from range; you win it the moment he dashes in with E (Hop) or sticks around to auto and you catch him with E (Death's Grasp).

brief.thesis: Gnar's entire kit is built around never being where your E (Death's Grasp) can land it on him. He can only hurt you from range in mini form or by committing an E (Hop) engage, and both of those are punishable windows if you track his Rage bar and dash cooldown. The 49.8% win rate over 1368 games reflects that this is genuinely even, decided by who flinches first in the poke-to-engage transition.

theirWindow.when: Mini Gnar kiting at max Q range
theirWindow.what: Boomerang Throw (Q, 1100 range) slows and chips you from outside your 675-range Obliterate and 700-range Death's Grasp. Don't chase; farm with Q and let him walk the damage off rather than eating repeated boomerangs trying to close distance.

yourWindow.when: Gnar uses E (Hop) to engage or stays in melee to auto
yourWindow.what: The instant he lands from Hop or steps inside 700 range to trade autos, fire E (Death's Grasp) to pull him in, then Q and auto to stack Darkness Rise. This is exactly the window OP.GG flags — he can't kite you if he's already in the pull radius.

start.why: Mana sustain to spam Q (Obliterate) in trades and extend through the early poke phase without recalling (50.7% win rate, 805 games).

boots.why: Reduces the steady auto-attack and Boomerang Throw chip damage mini Gnar relies on to win the poke war (49.5% win rate, 79.9% pick rate).

core.why: The slow from Q/E locks Gnar down the moment he's pulled in, stopping him from hopping away mid-fight.
Sustained-damage item that scales your extended E-into-Q-into-auto trade pattern and adds tankiness via omnivamp.
Burn damage punishes Gnar for staying in Death's Grasp range instead of kiting, completing the 61.3% win rate path over 137 games.

you're struggling to close the gap on mini Gnar before he transforms and need a second gap-closer alongside E

runes.keystoneWhy: Extended trades through E-pull into Q into autos stack Conqueror fast, and the healing keeps you ahead of Gnar's poke while Indestructible (W) is on cooldown.

summoners.why: Highest pick rate and win rate in this matchup (49.6%, 64.9% pick) — matches Mordekaiser's solo-kill advantage here, since Ignite closes out the kill once E (Death's Grasp) lands and R isolates him for the burn.

playing.title: Pull on every E (Hop)
playing.detail: The second Gnar lands his Hop inside 700 range, fire Death's Grasp immediately. This is the single highest-value window in the lane per OP.GG's own read of the matchup.

playing.title: Track the Rage bar constantly
playing.detail: Mini Gnar is the ranged threat; once Rage caps and he transforms, his kit flips to melee with a Wallop (W) stun. Don't get caught in melee range right as he transforms.

playing.title: Don't chase mini Gnar
playing.detail: Chasing into Boomerang Throw range just feeds him free poke. Hold position and farm with Q (Obliterate) until he's forced to engage or transform.

playing.title: Save R for overextensions
playing.detail: Realm of Death (140-80s cooldown) is your hard isolation tool — use it when Gnar pushes too far up, not as a first-engage, since he has no way to Hop or boulder-toss out of it once locked.

playing.title: Pop W (Indestructible) after tanking autos
playing.detail: Let the shield build from his poke damage, then consume it to heal right before your own E-into-Q trade so you win the exchange on HP.

playing.title: Respect level 6 Mega Gnar R
playing.detail: GNAR! knocks back and stuns anyone it slams into a wall for bonus damage — don't fight with your back to terrain once he's level 6 and Rage is near max.

playing.title: Hit the single-target Q angle
playing.detail: Obliterate's damage is increased against a single enemy, so in 1v1 trades line it up to only clip Gnar rather than minions when possible.

brief.patchCaveat: Build paths, rune pages, summoner spells, and win-rate figures above are measured from live OP.GG games on the current patch; the power-curve timing and trade-pattern reasoning are my own tactical read, not measured data.

stats.opponentTip: Do not let Gnar kite you easily by using [E] whenever he steps in range. After reaching level 6, be careful of Mega Gnar’s (R).
